speaker: REGINALD
description: REGINALD should sound like: Bellows loudly and forcefully during combat callouts; Male; Heavy, booming, shouting voice filled with dread and determination; Bold; Aggressive in combat; Protective; Brave; Desperate in battle; Adventurer who wields a giant hammer glowing yellow with mana; Frontline vanguard wielding a massive warhammer.
ref_text: “Please don’t mind Lucas. Let me introduce you to the party. My name is Reginald Brooks, and I’m an A-class augmenter. I am an earth-attribute, yellow-stage core and I specialize in the hammer.”
